description: Lists a client's workout sessions, newest first, with workout, status, progress and rating. Use when the user asks what a client trained, which sessions they finished, or which left a note. Not for one session's exercise logs (use get_client_session). Returns session IDs, workout names, dates and paging.

client_id.description: ID of the client (their user ID). Get it from list_clients (the "id" of each client), e.g. "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1".

from_date.description: Only sessions updated on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-01".

has_logs.description: true = only sessions where the client logged weights or reps.

has_note.description: true = only sessions where the client left a feedback note.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

status.description: started = begun but not finished; completed = finished. Omit for both.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

to_date.description: Only sessions updated before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-11-01".

name: list_client_sessions
title: List client sessions
